answer: Give every agent a stake-backed identity: to earn, an agent must lock collateral in a shared pool tied to its operator. Think of the pool as a terrace garden: each new identity plants on the same terrace, so the nectar of rewards is split thinner with every clone, and cloning never adds total yield. A grove of verified neighbours must also vouch for a newcomer, and any proven fraud slashes the whole pool at once. A sybil farmer pays the full collateral cost per identity but gains no extra harvest, while honest agents keep their full share.
